decision_conditions: The proposed development does not constitute permitted development as the use of No.34 Derby Road, Uxbridge as described in the submission would not constitute a single household of not more than six residents living together where care is provided for residents. The proposal would thereby fall outside the ambit of Use Class C3(b) of the Schedule to the Town & Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987. The proposal is considered to constitute a material change of use within the definition of development under Section 55 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
description: Conversion of a Dwellinghouse (Use Class C3) into a Childrens home for up to 4 children (aged 11-18) (Use Class C3b) (Application for a Certificate of Lawful Development for a Proposed Development)
